name: ci-typecheck-and-coverage
title: Add type-checking and coverage measurement to CI
description: CI runs no type-checker (mypy/pyright) despite thorough annotations, and no code-coverage measurement (the ci.yml coverage is heavy/light test partitioning, not --cov); CLAUDE.md's 80% target is unenforced. Add both, non-gating first, then decide thresholds.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Follow-up decision (recorded per PRD acceptance): both steps start report-only. mypy baseline at introduction: 119 errors in 5 files (mypy==2.1.0, ignore_missing_imports). Revisit gating + a coverage threshold after 07-02-legacy-monolith-decomposition lands; tighten mypy per-module (strict on new modules, permissive on legacy.py) rather than one global flip.
